name: Swimming
description: Lying face down with arms and legs lifted, flutter opposite arm and leg up and down as if swimming.

source.title: Swimming on the Mat (Online Pilates Classes)
source.note: Classic Pilates mat exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie face down with your arms reaching overhead and legs long.
Lift your head, chest, arms and legs slightly off the mat.
cues: Reach long through your fingers and toes.
Keep your neck long, looking down.
Small, quick beats with steady breathing.

prescription.note: Move with your breath, slowly and with control.

keyframes.name: Right arm, left leg up
keyframes.cue: Lift your right arm and left leg.
